answer: Why land beats headcount: bind every reward seat to one municipal allotment-garden plot deed. Before payout, post a ZK proof of a unique lease ID for the current season from the city registry. Acreage is finite—only as many deeds as a tilled ridge can hold—so a thousand ghost accounts collapse onto one lease. Example: twenty bots share one onyx-stamped lease PDF and count as a single crystal of standing; twenty gardeners with twenty separate plot deeds unlock twenty seats.
